authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. The official Local plan specification defines local-plan-boundary reference as a permanent unique boundary identifier, requires Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry, and provides organisation codes for responsible organisations. A bounded window of at most 50 records/identifier candidates was considered for the unresolved criterion. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative local-plan-boundary reference/name, local-plan reference/name, LPA/LAD/statistical-geography reference/name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Therefore no official boundary identifier can be selected without guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
